d: We are seeking an experienced Network & Cybersecurity Expert / Technical Lead to design, implement and support enterprise network and cybersecurity solutions.
This hands-on role requires strong expertise across the Fortinet product portfolio, advanced networking skills and proven experience leading a team of 5-10 engineers.
q: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline.
8-10+ years of networking and cybersecurity experience.
Mandatory certification: Fortinet NSE 7 or higher, or the current equivalent.
Strong hands-on experience with Fortinet security solutions.
Strong knowledge of BGP, OSPF, LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, VPN, high availability, routing, switching, segmentation, IPS/IDS and network security .
Proven experience designing, implementing and supporting enterprise cybersecurity solutions.
Strong customer-facing, communication and troubleshooting skills.
CISSP and/or CCIE are highly preferred; CCNP is also preferred.
Experience in Oman or GCC enterprise, government, banking, telecom or oil and gas environments is an advantage.
r: Design and implement secure enterprise network and cybersecurity solutions.
Provide expert-level support for FortiGate, FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer, FortiNAC, FortiAuthenticator, FortiSwitch, FortiAP, FortiWeb, FortiMail and SD-WAN .
Develop high-level and low-level designs (HLD/LLD), bills of materials, migration plans, methods of procedure (MOPs) and technical documentation.
Lead complex firewall, network security, VPN, SD-WAN and infrastructure implementations.
Provide L3/L4 troubleshooting and lead the resolution of critical incidents.
Lead, mentor and technically supervise 5-10 Network & Security Engineers .
Support customer technical discussions, solution architecture, presales and project delivery.
Coordinate with customers, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), vendors and internal project teams.

d: Anantara Hotels & Resorts is a global luxury hotel and resort brand rooted in Thai culture, with an intrinsic sense of authentic hospitality. Inspired by the Sanskrit word meaning ‘without end’, our spirit embodies freedom, movement, and harmony. We believe every journey should leave a lasting impression — for our guests and for our people.

Founded in 2001 in Thailand, we have since expanded across the world, welcoming guests in some of the world’s most captivating locales — from pristine beaches and private islands to ancient sites and vibrant metropolises. If you are driven by a passion for generosity, warmth and heartfelt hospitality, Anantara offers a career without limits.

The Sales Executive is responsible for developing and maintaining business relationships with government entities, corporate clients, local companies, and other key accounts. The role focuses on identifying new business opportunities, promoting the resort’s accommodation, dining, meetings, and event facilities, and contributing to revenue growth through effective sales activities and account management.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with government ministries, public sector entities, corporate companies, and local business partners.
Identify new business opportunities and expand the resort’s client base within assigned market segments.
Conduct regular sales calls, client visits, meetings, presentations, and property inspections.
Promote the resort’s accommodation, restaurants, meeting facilities, events, and other services to potential clients.
Secure corporate agreements, government business, room nights, meetings, and event opportunities.
Maintain regular contact with existing accounts to strengthen partnerships and encourage repeat business.
Prepare sales proposals, quotations, and agreements in line with the resort’s commercial guidelines.
Coordinate with Revenue, Reservations, Events, and other departments to meet client requirements.
Monitor local market trends, competitor activities, and opportunities to increase business from government and corporate segments.
Maintain accurate account records, sales activities, and production reports.
Participate in local networking events, business meetings, and relevant industry activities.
Work towards agreed sales targets and contribute to the resort’s overall commercial performance.
q: Diploma or degree in Hospitality, Business Administration, Sales, or a related field is preferred.
Previous experience in hotel sales, corporate sales, government accounts, or business development is an advantage.
Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
Good command of written and spoken English; Arabic is an advantage.
Good knowledge of the local market and the ability to build relationships with government and corporate clients.
Strong follow-up, organisation, and account management skills.
